name: Schmidt Steel GmbH
negotiation_history: Excellent partner for 8+ years. Typically offers 5-8% volume discounts for orders over 5000 units. Responds well to long-term contracts (12+ months) with improved pricing and priority scheduling. Last negotiation in Q3 2024 resulted in 7.5% discount on annual steel tube contract.

name: Hoffmann Steel Industries
negotiation_history: Reliable supplier for 5 years. Open to negotiations on lead time reductions for premium pricing (+3-5%). Offers standard 4-6% discounts for quarterly commitments. Previously accepted 6-month exclusivity agreement in exchange for 9% price reduction and 5-day lead time guarantee.

name: Stahlwerk Munich AG
negotiation_history: Mid-tier supplier, moderate negotiating flexibility. Typically requires MOQ of 1000 units but flexible on delivery schedules. Offers 3-5% discounts for upfront payment (Net 15 instead of Net 30). Recent negotiation achieved 4.5% discount with staged delivery terms.

name: Mueller Industries KG
negotiation_history: Problematic supplier with frequent delays. Low prices (typically 15-20% below market) but high risk. Quality issues reported in 2023-2024. Multiple failed delivery commitments. Not recommended for critical orders. Previous negotiations unsuccessful - supplier unable to meet improved lead time commitments despite premium offers.

name: AlphaMetals Distribution
negotiation_history: Specialized aluminum supplier, competitive on pricing for bulk orders. Offers 6-10% discounts on orders exceeding 10,000 units. Willing to negotiate on lead times with advance notice (3+ weeks). Last negotiation secured 8% discount plus expedited shipping for a 9-month supply agreement.

name: European Brass & Copper Co.
negotiation_history: Niche supplier for brass products with fair pricing. Flexible on payment terms - accepts Net 45-60 for established customers. Offers 4-7% volume discounts but requires quarterly forecasts. Quality consistent but lead times variable (7-14 days standard). Recent negotiation achieved better pricing (5.5% discount) in exchange for minimum quarterly order guarantee.
